settings.title: Personal lesson support
timeline.title: Supervisor activity
settings.body: Allow the supervisor to add reviewed explanations and practice within your course limits, propose source-linked learning preferences for your review in Learning memory, and note ideas about what may help you from your answers and questions, for you to correct or reject. While it is on, the AI model your course uses also receives your open ideas about what may help you, including ones you wrote and your corrections, to guide your teaching. Ideas you reject or that lapse are not sent, and nothing from other learners is included. Your independent checks and completion requirements stay the same. You can turn this off at any time.
